hook: Parties gear up for *3 city corporation* polls
hook_b: Parties gear up for *3 city corporation* polls
tldr: Elections to GHMC and the new Malkajgiri and Cyberabad corporations are expected soon; AIMIM has stepped up outreach.

beats.what: AIMIM floor leader Akbaruddin Owaisi has visited Chandrayangutta, Hafez Babanagar and Riyasatnagar and met traffic police on road safety.
beats.why: AIMIM won 44 of 150 wards in each of the last two GHMC elections and wants to contest the new corporations too.
beats.care: Your ward may have changed after delimitation; the new corporations mean new local representatives.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: AIMIM leaders also met senior GHMC officials on city development works.

cards.q: Do you know which corporation and ward you now fall under?

qs: How many wards does GHMC now have after delimitation?

facts.t: AIMIM won *44 of 150* wards in each of the last two GHMC elections.

viz.verdict: Same tally in each of the last two GHMC elections.

sources.title: AIMIM steps up public outreach ahead of GHMC, Malkajgiri and Cyberabad civic polls

fact: *Three* Hyderabad city corporations head toward polls as parties step up outreach
twist: GHMC's ward count has grown after delimitation added Shamshabad, Jalpally, Adibatla, Badangpet and Meerpet.
